notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape - Patch 1.0.2
notes.content: [p]Another patch, this time to fix an issue that prevented the alternate ending to be shown.[/p]

notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape - Patch 1.0.1
notes.content: [p]Hi all![/p][p]This is the first Steam patch for the game following the game's launch.[/p][p]Here's what's new:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed "Stage Clear" sections to prevent occasional issue where the game wouldn't move on to the next stage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare issue where the king would sometimes not appear in throne area[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some questionable enemy placement in 2 player mode[/p][/*][/list][p]Please let me know if you find any new issues or bugs.[/p]

notes.title: Town stage update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283499/cefbe93632b9e5d980acd6aedea39a1e123d0faa.png[/img]

Progress continues! The Town stage has been updated with tweaked, recolored graphics, additional enemies, and a formidable boss. Currently the stage is 90% complete (or more), only needing some fine tuning related to enemy placement.

notes.title: Buccaneers Shipshape demo available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283499/26261680d6aa55356e7f280d0e27c7f3689cd801.png[/img]

And here it is: the new demo of Buccaneers Shipshape!
Some updates include:
- Faster enemies and gameplay
- New health item
- New powerup: parrot assist
- New and improved animations
- New and updated enemies
- New tutorial screen
- Updated HUD and character icons
- Characters now have names!
- Updated stage's title card
- Added ability to perform special attack without MP (uses HP)
- New screen resolution (sprites look bigger in full screen)
- Tweaked layout of port stage
- And more!

notes.title: New Demo next week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42283499/0f737e9e316ae596ecff1f04d353549878ea1b53.png[/img]

Next week will see the release of a new demo of Buccaneers Shipshape. If you had the chance to play the previous demo, and are wondering about what's new, here's the list of changes:

- New health item
- New powerup: parrot assist
- New and improved animations
- New and updated enemies
- New tutorial screen
- Updated HUD and character icons
- Characters now have names!
- Updated stage's title card
- Added ability to perform special attack without MP (uses HP)
- New screen resolution (sprites look bigger in full screen)
- Tweaked layout of port stage
- And more!

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.content:
Demo Update!
I have incorporated your feedback and made improvements on the game. Version 0.1.3 includes the following revisions:
•	Forward throw added
•	Players are invulnerable during last attack of basic combo
•	Stage 2 boss: longer charge before attack
